verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows on-demand and pay-as-you-go Spot capacity without long-term commitments, plus billing usage insights and the FOCUS export API. None of it states per-second or per-minute billing granularity, or that charges stop when an instance or node is not running. Pay-as-you-go is about commitment terms, not metering granularity, so it does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
